about: Reviewed Beta action-matrix exceptions. Each entry binds a design/entity/action identity to its failure kind, a stable failure class, the reviewed evidence run and an issue. The historical baseline was recorded on the C++ SMLib backend and is not comparable with the Rust solidcore pin, so these 213 are a ratchet mismatch first, not proof of a fork-only kernel regression; see docs/kernel-attribution.md. The reviewed run also has 1085 pre-existing baseline failures and 972 unbaselined failures; neither is counted as a pass, and the unbaselined identities are reported for every run and are never passes. Beta promotion fails on an unlisted failure, a changed class, a missing shard, a build failure or an exception that starts passing. This is not a stable release waiver and is not a replacement for tests/action_matrix/baseline.json.
